description.value:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Gluttonous sekmins created this mutagen so they could eat daily without overindulging. A modified version allows the imbiber to convert excess calories into magical energy.

Benefit You gain resistance 15 to magical damage. Whenever you score a hit with a spell attack, add 1d6 force damage. The duration is 1 minute. In addition, any creature that damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes 3d6 force damage.

Drawback You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fatigued] until you eat a full meal, which requires at least 10 minutes.
